Human Trafficking Network Dismantled in North Dinajpur, Victims Rescued

Authorities have busted a human trafficking network in North Dinajpur, rescuing 41 victims during a 48-hour operation. This action is part of a broader global crackdown on human trafficking, which has seen over 1,000 arrests and the identification of more than 2,000 potential victims, predominantly women trafficked for sex.
